body: Discovery (orchestrator): `src/mcp/tools/chatNaming.test.ts` is not hermetic. The orchestrator runs inside a DM chat, so its shell inherits DM_DESKTOP_PIPE (the live desktop naming pipe), and `name_chat` then reaches the real app and returns applied:false instead of desktop_unavailable. With DM_DESKTOP_PIPE/DM_SESSION_TOKEN unset the test passes; this was observed with one targeted run, not a rerun-to-green. Fix for the test: clear the DM_* env in the test or harness. The acceptance node runs the DoD with a clean env (DM_* unset), matching CI. Pre-existing on main, not caused by this epic.
